justification: Dev tooling only: pulled in by @expo/cli for Expo code signing, never imported by the app or the backend. No patched release exists on npm (latest 1.4.0 is the last vulnerable version).

grpc-js 1.9.16 is pulled in by firebase / @react-native-firebase/app (@firebase/firestore pins ~1.9.0), not imported by app code, and is a Node-only library that cannot run in React Native. No fix within the allowed range: @firebase/firestore keeps ~1.9.0 even in the latest firebase.
